figures.title: Closures share bindings within one invocation
figures.description: Counter A increment and read both access call A count, now 2. Counter B read accesses a separate call B count, still 0.

figures.title: Call syntax supplies the ordinary-function receiver
figures.description: The property call meter.read supplies meter as this and returns 2. A detached plain strict call supplies undefined and reading this.value throws TypeError.

figures.title: Lookup delegates until an own property is found
figures.description: account has no own role. Lookup follows its prototype to shared and finds role viewer there, without continuing to Object.prototype or null.

figures.title: A new array can retain the same element objects
figures.description: Original index 0 and sorted index 1 reference object A. Original index 1 and sorted index 0 reference object B, whose score changes from 1 to 9.

figures.title: A live import follows the exporter’s binding
figures.description: The imported count reads the exporter binding, which increment changes from 0 to 1. A local primitive snapshot copied before increment remains 0.

figures.title: Cleanup can preserve or replace a pending outcome
figures.description: A pending return or throw enters finally. Normal finally completion preserves it; a return or throw from finally replaces it.

figures.title: Resolution can lock an outcome while settlement waits
figures.description: Resolving outer with a pending inner Promise leaves outer pending but locked to inner. Inner fulfillment leads to outer fulfillment; inner rejection leads to outer rejection.

figures.title: The executor runs now and the reaction runs later
figures.description: A logs first, the synchronous Promise executor logs B and resolves 5, then registers a reaction. C logs before the reaction job logs D.

figures.title: Aborting observation cannot undo a confirmed effect
figures.description: An operation succeeds for attempt R, its confirmation is lost, and the caller aborts afterward. The prior effect remains while the caller lacks confirmation.

figures.title: Awaiting each save delays the next pull
figures.description: The consumer pulls item 1, checks cancellation, and waits for its save to fulfill before pulling item 2. The source may buffer internally during the wait.

figures.title: Structural compatibility preserves the runtime object
figures.description: The checker accepts record with string id and category for Identified, which requires string id. At runtime input and record remain the same object and category still exists.

figures.title: Branches narrow the checker’s view of Booking
figures.description: A Booking starts as a union. A pending branch returns a waiting message. Otherwise a confirmed branch can read specialistId, leaving cancelled with reason on the final path.

figures.title: The chosen key determines the returned type
figures.description: For entry with string id and boolean active, keyof T is id or active. Choosing active makes K active and T[K] boolean; runtime execution is ordinary obj[key].

figures.title: Distribution changes where the union appears
figures.description: Wrap distributes over string and number and yields a union of two object types. WrapTogether tests the tuple-wrapped union together and yields one object type with a union-valued property.

figures.title: Checking, emission and loading answer separate questions
figures.description: The checker resolves source types. With emission enabled, JavaScript must still be inspected and its value imports resolved and evaluated by the runtime or bundler. noEmit produces no compiler output.

figures.title: Only executed checks establish this parser’s input contract
figures.description: The parser rejects null, arrays and non-objects, then checks a nonblank string name and safe integer age from 0 to 130. Failures throw; success constructs a new object with trimmed name and original age.

figures.title: Promise settlement and domain outcome are separate layers
